updates.note: Management stated they expect the working capital cycle to trend towards their long-term operating range of 45 to 50 days.
updates.quote: As these benefits gradually normalize, we expect the working capital cycle to trend towards our long-term operating range of 45 to 50 days.

updates.note: Management reiterated the FMEG margin guidance profile for FY30.
updates.quote: So over the longer term, I believe we would end up in that kind of a range of 8% to 10% of the EBITDA margin.

So I would like to take this opportunity to sort of also let the investor community know that in terms of our EHV plant timelines, we are expecting the EHV plant to now commission somewhere in FY 2028

updates.note: Management reiterated the medium to long-term EBITDA margin guidance range for Wires and Cables.
updates.quote: In line with our Project Spring roadmap, we remain confident of sustaining medium- to long-term EBITDA margins within our guided range of 11% to 13%.

updates.note: Management reiterated the FMEG business growth objective.
updates.quote: Our objective continues to be growing at 1.5x to 2x of the industry growth rate while steadily enhancing profitability.

updates.note: Management reiterated sustainable margins for the EPC business.
updates.quote: Over the medium- to long-term, we continue to expect sustainable margins for the EPC business to remain in the high single-digit range
